Honest scoring is the point: a pilot hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Water Currency Pilots Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Water Currency Pilots operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Water Currency Pilots installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 41548 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where water ledgers monitoring, pilot logistics redundancy, or scarcity pricing maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Water Currency Pilots Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Water Currency Pilots: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Water Currency Pilots — water rights as tradable currency.

Phase 1 — Prove (water ledgers): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (pilot logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (scarcity pricing): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (equity guards): pilot hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and basins-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
